mha_minoru_mineta.label: Minoru Mineta
mha_minoru_mineta.instructions: A high, thin, nasal young man with a whiny, sniveling edge: quick, breathy and eager, his voice cracks upward when he gets excited or scared and drops into a sleazy, wheedling murmur when he schemes. Clear and smooth, never hoarse, gravelly or raspy, never deep.
